name: micro-ROS (micro_ros_setup)
problems: provides only basic cross-platform support; deeper platform-specific integration requires separate per-platform components
requires tens of kilobytes of RAM at minimum, not suitable for the smallest microcontrollers
source_notes: Entry-point ROS 2 package for building micro-ROS firmware for embedded platforms, extending the ROS 2 ecosystem to resource-constrained microcontrollers via DDS-XRCE middleware. Licensed under Apache License 2.0.
